name: Diffusion Policy (CNN, Push-T)
family: Imitation policy: ResNet-18 encoder, 1D temporal U-Net, DDPM/DDIM

sources.title: C. Chi et al., Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion, arXiv:2303.04137 (HTML version)
sources.covers: Table 7 (CNN-based) Push-T row: ImgRes 1x96x96, CropRes 1x84x84, To 2, Ta 8, Tp 16; Appendix A.3 centre crop at inference

note: The simulated Push-T setting of the CNN-based policy (Table 7): one 96 × 96 camera view cropped to 84 × 84, random in training and "a static center crop with the same size" at inference (Appendix A.3). It is not a ViT (a ResNet-18 with spatial softmax pooling), so patch_px and tokens_per_image are null. 100 training and 100 evaluation diffusion iterations; the paper's 0.1 s latency is for the real-world settings (16 evaluation iterations on an RTX 3080, entry diffusion-policy-cnn) and is not entered here. To 2 observation steps. LeRobot's diffusion configuration defaults differ (horizon 64, n_action_steps 32, no crop); its Push-T checkpoint was not read.

crop_rule.quote: "During inference, we take a static center crop with the same size." (Appendix A.3)
